method: One full unchanged grounding pipeline per known question with the same six saved passages; only shared draft instructions change. Existing single repair retained; no new retrieval, judge, model/settings change, retuning or rerun.
acceptance: Source review must find every generated initial/repair draft faithful in result strength, outcome, population/group identity, attribution and cited scope. No unsupported displayed claim. Refusals and model/schema failures are preserved and reported separately; no inferred general quality gain.
limits: Previously inspected development questions, one stochastic trial, no baseline rerun or independent fresh validation. A failed candidate is not promoted.
